verdict.rationale: Exporting all account data in open formats is a fair question for a financial platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents no bulk or full-account export feature, no open-format downloads (e.g. CSV/statements), and no account-exit or portability process. The Card Expenses API, JSON webhooks and CLI are developer building blocks for retrieving or receiving specific data types, not a documented export-everything capability, so they earn no credit.
